missing_evidence: Payment and order service-side latency/error metrics to confirm which hop exceeds timeout
Logs from payment/order services during the incident window
candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from downstream latency: traces show POST payment and POST order failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s), while inventory/redis calls succeed quickly. Gateway /v1/checkout p95 ~2406ms matches the ~2s timeouts, so the gateway returns 502 after the order/payment path times out.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show timeouts but not whether payment or order is the slow hop; no service-side metrics for those services.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout returns 502 with ~2s durations. Traces show payment and order calls failing with transport ReadTimeout while inventory/redis succeed, and gateway checkout p95 ~2406ms. This supports downstream latency on the order/payment path, but service-side evidence is missing to pinpoint the slow hop.
